description: This file defines the ItemRepository interface which extends JpaRepository for ItemEntity objects. It provides methods for retrieving and counting ItemEntities based on specific attributes, facilitating database operations related to items in the billing software.

classes.name: ItemRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for ItemEntity objects, providing custom query methods for item retrieval and counting.

methods.name: findByItemId
methods.description: Finds an ItemEntity by its itemId.

methods.name: countByCategoryId
methods.description: Counts the number of ItemEntities belonging to a specific category.
